baseline.notes: JS is main.js from dashboard/src/main.ts (bun build --minify). The JS ceiling equals the T1 baseline, so there is zero headroom until T4 lowers the target to 120 KB. This is intended. CSS is dashboard/public/styles.css, tokens.css and fonts/fonts.css, the stylesheets the dashboard ships. The CSS ceiling is the spec's 25 KB. 2026-11-26: raised by 1,894 B (42,553 to 44,447) for the Quality tab (dashboard/src/views/quality.ts: scorecard, merge verifier, compute router, tournaments, acceptance tests, governance, trust boundary, cost), measured in CI (the CI runner's bun build measures about 430 B more than a local build). It reuses existing CSS classes and adds no dependency; the ceiling again equals the measured size, so there is still zero headroom.
